sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
So, what's the gameplay like in Spidey and his Amazing Friends: Swing Into Action!? Your character will run forward automatically, and you'll need to press the spacebar to jump or double jump to reach higher platforms and obstacles.


The spacebar is the primary control input in the game, and it's used to jump or double jump. You can also use the spacebar to dash, which is useful for navigating tight spaces and avoiding obstacles. The game also features a variety of power-ups and collectibles that can be used to boost your speed, invincibility, or score.
